component.name: WiFiman
component.summary: Ubiquiti desktop client for network scanning and UniFi Teleport VPN

description.p: WiFiman Desktop analyzes Wi-Fi and wired networks: it detects nearby devices, runs download/upload speed tests, and connects to a UniFi network remotely over the Teleport VPN. A WebKitGTK front-end drives a root system daemon that bundles its own WireGuard userspace tools.
